title: Sierra Leone administrative geography review
geography_note: The five broad administrative regions are used for the region lookup. The Electoral Commission's electoral geography splits Western Area into Western Rural and Western Urban; these electoral units are not mixed into the broad administrative region list. The reported 2026 gazetting of Bandajuma and Kpanguima creates district-level changes, not new first-level regions. Boundary crosswalks remain necessary.
lookup_change: Five broad administrative regions added to src/_data/calculator/regions.json on data/44-country-calculator-readiness. Lookup only; not activated.
readiness_gaps: Reconcile the 2025 MAFS crop-cutting ecology and district observations, including the national rice output-to-area ratio.
Verify the 2026 Gazette text and authoritative boundaries for Bandajuma and Kpanguima before district-level crosswalks.
Obtain dated regional farmgate prices and current seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs.
Build region-specific enterprise budgets, currency handling, calculator mapping and tests.
safeguards: No active calculator profile or formula changed.
Country remains inactive until all readiness criteria pass.
